title: Every Whisper Heard
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
There was a person, sad and scared,
Not knowing what to do,
So he called out, 'Please help me, Lord!'
And God heard, and He knew.

[Chorus]
Heavenly Father hears my voice,
Each whisper and each prayer,
So when I call, I'm not alone,
He listens; He is there.

[Verse 2]
God listened close and helped him through,
His heart grew calm and glad,
'I love the Lord,' he sang, 'for He
Hears me when I am sad.'

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes and whisper soft
The things you want to say,
He hears each word, you're not alone,
He's close to you; He'll stay.

[Chorus]
mood: Listening music. A hushed, close pulse like someone leaning in to hear a small voice, matching a story about God hearing every whisper. The sway is gentle and attentive, with quiet pauses that leave space for the child's own words. By the last verse it slows and sinks lower, thinning to almost nothing, so the last whisper is heard clearly.
